surface_mechanism_description: Alternating pulses of the Hf/Si precursor vapor mixture and ozone allow process temperatures below 400 °C to grow Hf xSi12xO2 film. The co-injection process enables the formation of homogeneous single-layer hafnium silicate films as deposited.
